# Beta Wiki

A wiki documenting Minecraft Beta 1.7.3's technical specification and network protocol.

Please go to the [GitHub Pages link](https://OpenBetaGroup.github.io/beta-wiki) to see the actual Wiki!

If you'd like to contribute, check the [Contributing page](/CONTRIBUTING)
